records.text: Candace Owens said locals could not identify the Evergreen house Delmer Martinez had been roofing or the contractor he worked for through permit searches.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Well, locals who were very interested in this began searching, and they could not determine what house he and his co-workers were working on or what contractor they were working for. ... So they should be able to do a quick permit search in Evergreen and say, oh, they were working on Joe's house down the street and went on their lunch break. ... Can't find anything. Researched every house to see what in Evergreen, which house he was working on. Can't determine it.

verification.notes: The claim concerns local permit searches and inability to identify a private roofing job or contractor. Live searches found reporting that Martinez was traveling to or from roofing work, but no comprehensive permit-search audit or authoritative record proving that every relevant property and contractor had been checked. No conclusive source was found.
